race.comment: PROFITEUR'S FIL (5) started at $1.60 and got the job done comfortably when resuming over 1100m at this circuit last start. Has only raced three times so there is plenty more to come from this three-year-old. IL FRATELLO (2) tracked the speed then closed well to finish third when resuming over 1000m at the Gold Coast recently. Needs the extra trip at this stage and from an inside draw gets all the favours. BELLARATA (6) raced wide so her effort to be beaten three lengths over this distance at Grafton last time was satisfactory. Draws a bit closer today and at the third run back she shapes as a genuine contender. NINE MILL (4) disappointed as favourite first-up at Ipswich but has only been to the races twice so deserves another chance. CHAMPAGNE PROBLEMS (11) will be cherry ripe after two runs back from a spell and should enjoy the gun run out of the inside stall.
